scripts.sync-core: cd ../electrace && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && cd ../web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),d='node_modules/@electrace/core';fs.existsSync(d)?(fs.cpSync('../electrace/dist',d+'/dist',{recursive:true}),console.log('synced dist in place')):cp.execSync('npm install',{stdio:'inherit'})"
